d:
The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, has reported a massive security incident involving an estimated $6.3 billion worth of compromised crypto assets. That's over ₹55,000 crore!
But how did hackers allegedly breach Binance's systems? Was an employee's compromised laptop the entry point? And what does this incident mean for millions of crypto investors?
In this explainer, we break down the Binance security breach of October 29, 2026, including:
• How the suspected cyberattack took place.
• The alleged role of a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop.
